description: Integrator: it adds its input into a running total at a set rate, holds that total when the input is at zero, and can be made to leak back towards zero over a set time

params.text: Sets how fast the input is added into the total, -5 to 5 in octaves around whichever range the switch chooses, the hover text reading the result in hertz
Sets how long the total takes to fall to about a third of itself with no input, from no leak at all at fully counter-clockwise to a short time constant at fully clockwise
Sets which decade the RATE knob works in: L runs 6.25mHz to 6.4Hz, M runs 0.125Hz to 128Hz, H runs 25Hz to 25.6kHz
Chooses what happens at the voltage limit: CLIP holds the total there, FOLD turns the output back from it, RESET drops the total to 0V
Sets the total straight back to 0V
While it is held down, the voltage set by the INIT knob is added to the input, which is how a total is started from nothing
Sets the voltage the INIT button adds to the input, -10V to 10V
Attenuates and inverts the RATE jack, -1 to 1, before that voltage is added to the RATE knob
Attenuates and inverts the LEAK jack, -1 to 1, before that voltage is added to the LEAK knob
Switches between integrating only while the GATE jack is above 0V and integrating only while it is at exactly 0V

inputs.text: The voltage added into the total; every channel of a polyphonic cable is summed first
Stops and starts the integration; which way round it works is set by the gate-mode button, and with no cable here integration always runs
Divided by 2, scaled by its attenuverter and added to the RATE knob, so 2V at a full attenuverter moves the rate by one octave
Divided by 10, scaled by its attenuverter and added to the LEAK knob, the total clamped to the knob's own range
A rise past 1V sets the total straight back to 0V

outputs.text: The running total, held to the voltage limit the menu sets in the way the switch chooses

notes: on the FOLD setting only the output is folded; the total inside the module keeps growing past the limit, so it can take a while to come back once the input is removed
the gate test for the low setting is against exactly 0V, so a gate that idles at a few millivolts stops the integration on that setting
menu: Range: -5V..5V, -10V..10V — sets the voltage limit the CLIP, FOLD and RESET switch acts at

inputs.1:
high above 0V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads always integrating.
inputs.2:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.3:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
inputs.4: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
